svg.title: Three CECEC logo concepts
svg.desc: Three logo concept variations for CECEC, the Central and Eastern European Cheminformatics Conference, combining chemistry and data motifs with the CECEC wordmark.

text.tspan: Benzene-ring hexagon doubles as a network node — chemistry meets data.

svg.text: Concept 2 — Molecule map of the region

text.tspan: A molecule of scattered atoms, one larger central atom standing in for
The middle C becomes an atom with an orbiting electron - wordmark
and chemistry fused into one glyph.
